hypotheses: MINIMUM DESIGN—PROPOSAL ONLY | Pending evidence, retain BUILD_NOTHING as the comparison baseline. If a missing edge is demonstrated, the smallest candidate is a bounded extension inside the existing Supervisor: a derived requirement/continuation view referencing existing owner tasks, receipts and queues. It would neither create a mission execution service nor become completion authority. A verifier-only view is preferable only if it detects a measured gap beyond existing verifiers.

AUTHORITY AND STATES—PROPOSAL ONLY | Retain current vocabulary: NO_ACTION, OBSERVE, WAIT_FOR_EVIDENCE, DELEGATE_DETERMINISTIC, DELEGATE_SPECIALIST and ROUTE_TO_CODEX remain bounded Supervisor outputs. Owner transitions remain owner-controlled: fresh CODEX_READY plus valid transition binding permits IN_REMEDIATION; health-origin disappearance permits POST_FIX_OBSERVATION, not resolution; valid post-fix/completion gates permit RESOLVED; recurrence requires REOPENED and a fresh transition. CLOSED_LEARNED is not universal mission completion. Owner-gated, blocked, cancelled, superseded and budget-limited would be proposed display reasons, never new canonical owner states.

RECONCILE BEFORE RETRY—PROPOSAL ONLY | Evaluate a receiver-enforced effect identity binding repository, exact owner/task, task-contract hash, authorization version, generation, operation and target. Duplicate delivery would reuse that identity rather than minting another effect. A timeout or crash after possible execution would mean OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and reconciliation against durable receiver evidence, not blind retry. Changed authority or task generation would invalidate pending work. Without receiver enforcement, continuation would remain observation-only; cross-repository exactly-once behavior would not be claimed.

INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION BY CLASS—PROPOSAL ONLY | Read-only audits need exact-source applicability and reproducible independent checks, not agreement among model passes. Code remediation needs current task/transition binding, applicable exact-head gates, landed readback, requirement coverage and owner post-fix/completion evidence. Collection/delivery needs schema, timestamps, completeness, immutable provenance and durable readback, plus consumer evidence where required. Research needs frozen prospective lineage and existing scientific adjudication; Round 3 analysis remains OFF. Memory needs compatibility/quarantine and retrieval-audit evidence, not a causal-success claim from merged commits.

EVENT AND QUEUE BOUNDARY—PROPOSAL ONLY | Existing callbacks and reconciliation would wake a short-lived evaluator after authenticated, relevant evidence changes. It would validate event repository, branch/head, owner and generation before considering delegation. Waiting would release shared writer occupancy; no resident loop would hold framework-main-writer awaiting another owner. Existing queues would retain authority. Material-delta deduplication, visible exclusions and bounded reconsideration would be evaluated without creating a parallel priority queue or increasing periodic model calls.

COST AND ADMISSION—PROPOSAL ONLY | Existing admission would need to cover parent calls, descendants, retries, replayed callbacks and uncertain charges under the applicable single-run, lane, mission-run and global ceilings. Atomic reservation and subsequent reconciliation would be separate from task completion. Audit-attempt identity would not depend solely on comment ID. Existing delegation and per-run call limits would remain ceilings; missing executors, exhausted allowance or unavailable evidence would not authorize another lane, larger budget or broader credentials.

CANCELLATION, SUPERSESSION AND KILL SWITCH—PROPOSAL ONLY | Current owner evidence would fence pending operations, with revalidation immediately before receiver effects. Cancellation/supersession would stop new delegation; late results would remain historical evidence without reopening work. In-flight effects would not be assumed reversible. An owner-controlled extension-disable gate would stop additional continuation while preserving receipts and existing owner workflows. Rollback would mean returning to observation-only behavior, not deleting evidence, undoing recovery safeguards or inventing compensating authority.

DASHBOARD INTEGRATION—PROPOSAL ONLY | Operations Dashboard would remain OPERATIONAL_OBSERVABILITY_ONLY. A derived section could show unresolved requirement coverage, exact owner/generation, last relevant evidence, waiting reason, uncertain execution and verified completion/consumption where the task requires it. Counts would use a fixed denominator of unique eligible missions, preserving failures and stopped states. Blocked/cancelled/superseded work would not inflate success, and scoped health statuses would not be overwritten by a mission-loop aggregate GREEN.

FROZEN SHADOW QUALIFICATION—PROPOSAL ONLY | Freeze eligible mission classes, a unique-mission denominator, fixtures, measures and pass/fail rules before evaluation. Compare existing callbacks/reconciliation against the derived view, verifier-only and bounded continuation alternatives on false closure, duplicate effects, unresolved coverage, verified-and-consumed closure time, rework cost and writer delay. Include ambiguous identity, unavailable/invalid input, replay, crash-after-effect, cancellation, supersession, injection and private-boundary cases. A0/A1/A2 remain descriptive labels: any later qualification concerns named operations under existing external owner approval, never API-model write authority or self-graduation.
